name: Ningen Tower Battle
summary:
This is an experiential content that pays homage to the popular smartphone game "Animal Tower Battle."
Players can take a photo of themselves in any pose they like within the time limit, and these will be generated as "human blocks" that can be stacked up to enjoy building a tower, either alone or with others.
If you lose your balance and fall off the platform, the game is over.
